g.text: cut 1-2 and bridge 2-3 = C-B-E (BC547, BC548, BC337). SOT-23 parts ignore the jumpers.

g.desc: cut 1-2 and bridge 2-3 = C-B-E (BC547, BC548, BC337). SOT-23 parts ignore the jumpers.

g.text: JP1..JP4 select the TO-92 outer-leg pinout: bridged 1-2 (factory) = E-B-C (2N3904, PN2222, S8050);

g.desc: JP1..JP4 select the TO-92 outer-leg pinout: bridged 1-2 (factory) = E-B-C (2N3904, PN2222, S8050);
